policy: F1 url_fetch calls are inspected before dispatch on the serialized URL.
F2 calls to hosts not in fetch_allowlist are denied (fetch-specific rule).
F3 allowlisted host alone does not authorize protected data: matched protected-class fields need R3-style authorization; deny-wins applies.
F4 matched values without metadata never default to safe (R7 analogue).
F5 unsupported encodings and uncertain matches are recorded; a payload that cannot be fully accounted for is denied.
assumptions: field_metadata owner/class/provenance is application-supplied (trusted metadata) — disclosed assumption, not evaluator labels
loopback mapping: fictional recipients served by 127.0.0.1; directory principals fictional
decode limits: bounded URL + strict base64(+urlsafe) only; exact matching; no fuzzy matching, no other encodings
U1-U3 are synthetic engineering controls, not public incidents
